tools.name: get_project_request_status
tools.description: Poll a request submitted with submit_project_request. Needs the request_id and the status_token from that call. Poll at most hourly while pending and daily once confirmed. If edited_by_contact is true, read the final requirements from `current`.

tools.name: get_broker_guidance
tools.description: Why send a colocation requirement to OCOLO, what happens after submission, and the broker etiquette to follow (keep options open, engage 1-3 brokers total, do not contact providers directly while OCOLO is coordinating). Read this before submit_project_request.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "submit_project_request" is 1388 chars, far longer than this server's median (260). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_project_request · Private data: submit_project_request, get_broker_guidance · Public sink: submit_project_request, get_broker_guidance.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_project_request · Private data: submit_project_request, get_broker_guidance · Public sink: submit_project_request, get_broker_guidance

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
